sequence_strategy: monotonic aggregate version; reject version <= persisted version
duplicate_strategy: persist processed message id atomically with state update
replay_strategy: replayed messages pass through the same stale-version and idempotency guards

findings.finding: Parallel consumers can observe delayed delivery for the same aggregate.
findings.evidence: Concurrency is greater than one, but all messages for an order share the same partition key and version guard.
findings.recommended_action: Keep per-order partitioning and retain the monotonic version check.
